newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-NEGRI DOUBLE STRIKE SPARKS RANGERS WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEGRI DOUBLE STRIKE SPARKS RANGERS WIN.

text.p: Italian striker Marco Negri gave Glasgow Rangers a flying start to their quest for a 10th consecutive Scottish championship on Monday.
Negri, signed in the off season from Perugia for 3.7 million pounds ($6 million), scored twice in a minute as Rangers opened their premier division campaign with a 3-1 home win against Hearts.
The Italian's double strike came in the 39th and 40th minutes, with an element of controversy about his opening goal.

A shot from Dane Brian Laudrup was parried by goalkeeper Gilles Russet and Negri gathered the loose ball and just managed to bundle it in, the goal being given despite Hearts protests the ball had not crossed the line.
There was no doubt about Negri's second effort, however, when he took advantage of a mix-up between two defenders and chipped the goalkeeper from just inside the penalty box.
Rangers wrapped up their win with an 85th minute goal from Alex Cleland, though their Edinburgh opponents reduced the deficit two minutes later through substitute Colin Cameron.
